vitrina_lrv: This is the LRV {directo}, the Apollo 17 lunar rover. The astronauts drove it in 1972 {exacto} and it stayed on the Moon. Soon you'll get to explore its mission {cercano}.
vitrina_perseverance: This is Perseverance {directo}, a Mars rover. It landed in Jezero Crater in February 2021 {exacto} and it's still exploring the planet. Soon you'll get to explore its mission {cercano}.
regreso_museo: Great tour {cercano}. When the mission is ready, you'll be able to live it in full.
ayuda: Walk by raising your knees · tilt your head to turn · point at a showcase for 1.5 s · clap to enter
calibracion_instruccion: Look straight ahead, keep your head still and your hands relaxed.
luna_entrando_museo: Apollo 17 simulation: you're in the Taurus-Littrow valley, next to the Challenger lunar module. Walk to the lunar rover and clap to climb aboard.
luna_lejos_LRV: Get closer to the rover to climb aboard.
luna_sentado_en_LRV: You're in. Use the steering wheel to turn and walk to move forward. The rock with the blue halo is to the south; in the game it's much closer than the real Station 1.
luna_cerca_de_roca: You're next to the rock. Strike it with the hammer.
luna_golpeando: Now close your hand to grab it.
luna_golpe_fallido: You didn't make it in time. Get close again.
luna_muestra_recogida: Sample collected. Clap to return to the museum.
opc_suavizado: Cursor smoothing (0.05 very smooth · 1 no filter)
opc_tiempo_oculta_mano: Seconds without seeing the hand before it disappears
opc_umbral_salto_mano: Maximum jump to glide when it reappears (m)
inicio_elige: Choose how you want to play.
inicio_control_camara_desc: Walk by raising your knees, turn by tilting your head and point with your finger. Needs a webcam.
inicio_control_teclado_desc: W A S D to walk, mouse to look around and click to point. Doesn't use the camera.
inicio_camara_fallo: Couldn't use the camera ({error}). You can play with keyboard and mouse, or try the camera again.
ayuda_teclado: W A S D: walk · mouse: look · hold E or click a showcase for 1.5 s · space: clap · F or right click: grab · Esc: options
teclado_clic_mirar: Click on the scene to look around with the mouse.
opc_cambiar_control: Change control (returns to the start screen)
luna_entrando_museo_teclado: Apollo 17 simulation: you're in the Taurus-Littrow valley, next to the Challenger lunar module. Walk with W to the lunar rover and press space to climb aboard.
luna_lejos_LRV_teclado: Get closer to the rover and press space to climb aboard.
luna_sentado_en_LRV_teclado: You're in. Use A and D to turn and W to move forward. The rock with the blue halo is to the south; in the game it's much closer than the real Station 1.
luna_cerca_de_roca_teclado: You're next to the rock. Strike it with the hammer: press E or click.
luna_golpeando_teclado: Now grab it: press F or right click.
luna_muestra_recogida_teclado: Sample collected. Press space to return to the museum.
